title: Space Image Format
description: Decode a layered space image by stacking transparent layers to reveal a hidden message.
writeup:
## Approach

The image is a flat digit string split into 25x6 layers. Two tasks: a corruption check, then compositing.

## Part 1

Find the layer with the fewest `0` digits. On that layer, multiply the count of `1` digits by the count of `2` digits. Simple `min()` with a key function.

## Part 2

Flatten the layers front-to-back: for each pixel position, the first non-transparent (`2`) value wins. The result is a 25x6 grid of `0` (black) and `1` (white) pixels that spell out a five-letter code. Render `1` as a visible character and `0` as space to read it.
